0.content: After the Traveler's sibling arrived in Khaenri'ah, Irmin named them his heir. He and the Court of Khaenri'ah loudly proclaimed the strength and hope the new crown prince or princess would bring, and the people hailed them as a saviour. Dainsleif, then a young knight, kept order in the palace plaza that day. Looking back, he calls the title nothing but the Vinster King's lust for power (5.7). The king later led the heir down to the kingdom's deepest depths to serve as a vessel for unlimited Abyssal power.

1.content: Vedrfolnir, the court seer, was one of the two men the king trusted most. After he told the king at court that Khaenri'ah would fall if he continued on his path, Irmin had both his eyes gouged out and threw him into a filthy cell. In prison, Vedrfolnir said what surprised him was the king's sheer ignorance and how unfairly the world answers earnest counsel. His brother Dainsleif responded by planning the palace raid that created the Five Sinners.

2.comment: Irmin: The purge of the Crimson Moon
2.content: Long after the Crimson Moon Dynasty fell, Irmin still coveted the secrets it had left behind and saw its surviving bloodline as a threat. He secretly had his agent Rerir, the "Rächer of Solnari", hunt the remaining descendants. Rerir's files include a teacher as well as orphaned teenagers and children. The purge spread from the direct line to distant offshoots, and when Rerir found his own fiancee Tholindis among them, he cried out against "Irminsul" and turned on the king.
